name: Weighted average across opening, purchase and sale
description: The reference case the constitution spells out. Every figure below was
computed by hand and appears verbatim in NON_NEGOTIABLES §3.
Implementations may change; these numbers may not. If a change to the
costing code makes this file fail, the code is wrong — not the file.

$comment: The same figures before presentation rounding. Amounts are numeric(19,4)
and the weighted average is numeric(19,6), per ADR-0011. These are what
gets stored; the values above are what gets shown.
inventoryValue and inventoryGlBalance differ by Rs 0.0001 at storage
scale, while both present as Rs 9,533.33. Invariant 10 requires the
inventory ledger valuation to reconcile to the inventory GL balance
exactly, and §4 forbids tolerances in an invariant check — but
ADR-0007's compliance section says 'within the documented rounding
The residual is asserted below so it cannot drift while the ruling is
